related_adrs: ADR-0346 (legacy local mirror provenance; oya-ci-required/cloud-ci owns live CI authority)
title: Cloud toolchain target — Bazel rules_rust build graph + Jenkins-sole CI + RBE/affected-targets + oya governance overlay
purpose: Consolidated target for the build + CI/CD + verify toolchain overhaul. Bazel rules_rust is the build graph (hermetic, RBE, affected-target selection; Cargo.toml stays dependency SSOT via crate_universe); Jenkins is the sole CI (ADR-0359, GitHub Actions removed); oya is the governance/verify overlay delegating build/test to bazel. Honest non-claim: target spec; no Bazel adoption, RBE, Jenkins controller, or runtime is implemented here.

build_graph.system: Bazel + rules_rust (chosen over Buck2: Cargo.toml-as-SSOT via crate_universe, no Reindeer vendoring, mature OSS RBE)
build_graph.remote: remote build execution + hermetic remote cache (sccache->SeaweedFS today; bazel RBE target); --remote_download_minimal; async cache upload
build_graph.affected_targets: bazel query rdeps(//..., <changed files>) for presubmit affected-target selection (Google TAP model); no full-workspace rebuild on small changes
build_graph.incremental: no incremental compilation in CI (from-scratch + remote cache); incremental local only

ci.orchestrator: Jenkins LTS = sole CI (ADR-0359); GitHub Actions removed
ci.config: JCasC-only controller; ephemeral Kata K8s agents (Karpenter-elastic); RBAC + OpenBao credentials
ci.pr_gating: Jenkins GitHub App reports commit statuses; branch-protection required checks = Jenkins status contexts
ci.test_runner: cargo-nextest (process-per-test, --partition count:m/n sharding across agents, retries+flaky detection, fail-fast=false, JUnit)
ci.local_dev: bacon for the local watch loop (shift-left); legacy oya verify mirror (ADR-0346) for local-feedback/provenance only; cloud-ci/oya-ci required context owns live CI authority

oya_overlay.role: governance/verify orchestrator; delegates build/test to bazel query/test; runs only the bespoke governance gates
oya_overlay.retires: the duplicated cargo-mirror verify/run-all engine (no double cargo runs); affected-scope default + --ci-required full mirror

merge_and_delivery.merge_queue: speculative + batch (ADR-0111): test A vs main, B vs main+A, ...; always-green trunk
merge_and_delivery.progressive_delivery: ArgoCD + Argo Rollouts: canary -> bake-time SLO observation -> automatic metric-gated rollback (ADR-0349); cosign-verified images (ADR-0181)

non_claims: Target spec only; no Bazel MODULE.bazel/rules_rust adoption, no RBE, no Jenkins controller/agents, no GitHub App, no migration executed.
No CI-throughput/cache-hit/SLO measurement; all parity/performance claims stay blocked_until_required_evidence_is_green.
